Definition: something met with, i.e. an accident or fortune
BiblicalUsage: The word is a chance, a hap, a thing that happens, and Scripture uses it to test whether anything happens by chance at all. Ruth's hap was to light on the part of the field belonging to Boaz, the Preacher says one event happens to the wise and to the fool alike, and the Philistines called the plague a chance — but the ark went up to Beth-shemesh by the hand of God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe there is no such thing as chance in God's world. What looks like a hap is providence wearing work clothes, and Ruth's chance meeting was the way God brought the Messiah's grandmother home.
